overview: In the 1800s, a young native American named Talako is caught with Lara, wife of the merciless pirate Redbeard, who then orders for him to be burned alive. Witnessing Talako's execution, Redbeard's wife Lara hangs herself. Talako's spirit never ascends & haunts anyone who comes near the old house. Almost 300 years later, Lara and Talako meet face-to-face and learn that everything happens for a reason.

title: Unboxing Gone Wrong
overview: This is found footage of an unboxing video gone horribly wrong.

title: Lair of the Killer Clowns
overview: A paranormal researcher discovers a hellish no man's land in a forgotten desert that serves as a purgatory to evil clowns awaiting their fates.

title: Transformer
overview: A family is rocked by a split opinion on a seemingly mundane topic.
tagline: NO TRANSFORMER WOULD EVER DO THIS!

title: Scissors
overview: Courtney and her influencer friends are making a horror movie based on an urban legend.  Faced with an early start time the next day, the group decides to spend the night in a creepy, old house. But when someone puts on the costume and begins killing them one by one,  the remaining survivors must unravel the mystery of the killer’s identity and stop them before it is too late.

title: A Good Scream
overview: An aspiring voice-over actress gets the chance to work with a famous horror director and will stop at nothing to give a good performance, much to the chagrin of her neighbors.

title: Nosepicker
overview: A short 'tale of the unexpected' about an 8-year-old schoolboy with a nasty habit of picking his nose. Bullied by his classmates, unhelped by authority figures, Georgie retreats into his habit, with macabre results.

title: Blood on the Screen
overview: When a young man receives an old VHS box TV on his porch, he has no idea what horrors await him. As he plugs it in and watches a cooking show featuring Chef Kevin, the TV takes control of his mind, leading him down a path of paranoia and instability. As the night progresses, the lines between reality and fiction become increasingly blurred, and the protagonist becomes desperate to escape the TV's grip.

title: Necronomicon
overview: From the mind of HP Lovecraft comes the story of a book made from human flesh and written by Aleister Crowley during his visit to the depths of hell

title: Pruning
overview: When a far-right political commentator discovers she has inspired a mass shooting, she must contend with her conscience – by any means necessary.

title: Bears on a Ship
overview: During an airline strike in Mexico, a group of stranded passengers decide to take a ship voyage back home to the United States. Unbeknownst to them however, there are two more passengers aboard that ship. More specifically; man-eating bears!

title: Woman in the Maze
overview: A young woman rents a cursed house, forcing her to solve the mystery to find a way out.
tagline: She can get in, but can she get out?

title: It Feeds
overview: A clairvoyant therapist confronts her own personal demons while trying to save a young girl who believes a malevolent entity is feeding on her.

title: Ragdoll
overview: When her family moves into a new house, a young girl develops a connection with a mysterious rag doll that was left behind by the previous owner.

title: The Fuzzies
overview: Childhood friends reunite at the eerie and spooky estate of their famous friend to mourn her passing. They experience what nightmares are made of as grotesque puppets and sinister stop-motion creatures make them fight for their lives.
tagline: The show isn't over until Sunny says so.

title: XXX-Mas
overview: A blood-thirsty Santa wreaks havoc on the set of an eccentric adult film director's latest production.

title: thE RiNGiNG iN ouR EARS
overview: A mysterious sound plagues two arguing college students, they must figure out where it's coming from before they slowly go insane.

title: Down Below
overview: On the 20th anniversary of the gruesome Christmas Eve murders at St. Agnes church, a demonic preacher returns to haunt that same town's residents.

title: Faceless After Dark
overview: Following her breakout role in a killer clown horror flick, Bowie now finds herself struggling to capitalize on its success, but when she is suddenly held hostage by an unhinged fan posing as that same killer clown, horror becomes her reality as she fights to survive the night and escape before he completes his sinister plan to recreate the film's fatal plot.
tagline: The calls are coming from inside the house.

title: The Horror We Make
overview: A documentary featuring interviews from horror movie icons, filmmakers, actors and enthusiasts of the genre. Together they discuss why the horror genre is so important to creators and fans.

title: Bad Ben: The Dracula Situation
overview: Tom Riley once again owns the house on Steelmanville Road and upon taking possession, he discovers the previous owner had rented space to...Dracula. He then learns that he can't get rid of him because he has a lease so he has...a Dracula Situation.

title: X MILITARY
overview: A soldier abandoned by the government exists trapped inside of a dilapidated apartment. The only thing keeping him company is a radio, and a dead body.

title: Up, Up, & Up
overview: Cassius is a lonesome photographer who is sent over the edge when he meditates to help with the grief of his late lover.

title: In the Static
overview: A paranoid woman returns to work after witnessing a traumatic experiment in her office's laboratory, only to discover her coworkers may be trying to kill her.

title: Eldritch, USA
overview: Siblings Geoff and Rich Brewer have competed all their lives for parental affection, career ambitions, and romantic pursuits. Rich, the elder brother, always comes out on top leaving Geoff to struggle in his shadow. Tragedy strikes their family in a freak accident. In a panic, Geoff seeks out a backwoods cult rumored to have supernatural powers. The bumbling cult's ritual initially solves the problem, but it soon becomes apparent that they have unleashed a sinister force on their unsuspecting, Midwestern town.

title: A Better Man
overview: The harrowing experiences of a friend group reveal the impacts of toxic masculinity.
tagline: One becomes invisible as the other becomes transparent.

title: Bring Her to Me
overview: A woman is plagued by nightmares about traveling to a dark realm and a demonic entity that awaits her arrival. With the help of a friend, she consults a dream interpreter to end the nightmares, only to find that no one is who they seem and the real horror is about to begin.

title: Emptiness
overview: Suzanne’s husband has disappeared and she has no idea where he is. She’s stuck in her old house with Linda and Nicole who just won’t leave her alone. Linda is caring and wants to help Suzanne whereas Nicole is mounting suspicions on her. While looking for hints about her husband’s disappearance, a presence seems to prevent her from doing so. Is the house haunted or is Nicole playing a trick on her?

title: Big Easy Queens
overview: After Minnie Bouvèé, Mob Queen of the Quarter, has her arch-nemesis Poodles Makenzie’s crew brutally slaughtered, she braces for the blowback; what she doesn’t expect, however, is to be stalked by a creepy masked figure who leaves behind bouquets of gardenias and terrifying notes. Is this Poodles’ revenge, or the work of Minnie’s estranged sister who stole her man years ago and has suddenly reappeared?

title: The Puppetman
overview: The Puppetman, a convicted killer on death row, always maintained his innocence saying that it was an evil force controlling his body as he slaughtered his victims. Now Michal, the killer's daughter, begins to suspect that there may be some truth to her father's claim when those around her begin to die in brutal ways. She must try and break the curse of The Puppetman before all her loved ones are killed.

title: Ghosts of the Void
overview: Spending the night in her car, a newly homeless woman wrestles with exhaustion, her crumbling marriage, and the threat of mysterious, masked strangers.

title: A Really Haunted Loud House
overview: Lincoln and his best friend, Clyde, struggle to decide whether to participate in the Loud family Spooktacular, attend their friend, Xander's, party, or go trick-or-treating on Halloween.

title: Sorry, Charlie
overview: A remote helpline volunteer is targeted by "The Gentleman," a stranger who lures women from their homes with a recording of a crying baby.

title: Psychosis
overview: A criminal fixer who experiences auditory hallucinations must confront old demons when a new contract drags him into a surreal maelstrom of mind-altering drugs, delusional vigilantes and a sadistic hypnotist who seems more monster than man.

title: The Deep Web: Murdershow
overview: A podcaster’s investigation of his sister’s death leads him to a grisly website, where the highest bidder decides how a chosen victim will be killed.

title: Cabin Girl
overview: When a van-life influencer moves into an isolated cabin, she discovers the home has a dark history and becomes haunted by a troubled spirit.

title: Meet the Killer Parents
overview: A young woman fights to escape her boyfriend’s wealthy family after learning they’re planning to drug and groom her to replace their long-dead daughter.

title: Location 4
overview: After getting lost during a late night work session, two location scouts start to get the feeling they aren't the only two people on the mountain.

title: The Tip
overview: Jamie, an innocent pizza guy, awakens to find himself tied to a chair in the middle of a garage at the mercy of two suburban cultists.

title: Nice You Meet Me
overview: After flubbing his words during an important pitch meeting, Dilvus Shrivelman finds himself trapped in a thought spiral.  Paranoid that he’s lost his only lifeline to success, he becomes desperate to prove that he’s still got what it takes to be a big time business boy. But desperation quickly takes him into some not-so-chill territory.
tagline: Dilvus Shrivelman was about to take the business world by storm, until one grammatical mistake fucked his life to pieces.

title: Make The Call
overview: Two former best friends reunite in a changed world, finally confronting the demons that ripped them apart.

title: This Dinner Will End
overview: Unassuming Calvin comes into contact with a paranormal spirit, Cecilia, before his impromptu dinner party.
tagline: EAT YOUR WORDS, CHEW YOUR EGO, REGURGITATE YOUR PRIDE

title: Loop Track
overview: A four-day journey turns into a fight for survival. This is a psychological thriller about Ian, who wants to get as far away from humanity as possible, into the New Zealand bush. Some other individuals get attached to him. And he has the feeling that they are being followed. Is that real though?

title: The Stalking
overview: A witch conjures up evil spirits in the form of malignant sunflower plants which wreak havoc on a small suburban town. And a group of bullied teens must fight to survive these and other terrors that await them on Halloween Night.

title: 12 to Midnight
overview: A detective, despondent after the murder of his wife and forced to resign, is brought back to the force when a serial killer appears to be taunting him and turns out to be superhuman.
tagline: One Last Case. Terror In The Moonlight.

title: Distance.
overview: While a global pandemic of apocalyptic proportions affects society, Ace and Tyler reach a crossroads in their relationship.

title: Deep End
overview: On a hot summer day, a young man learns the terrifying secret behind an abandoned swimming pool...

title: Snakeeater
overview: Against the backdrop of a decaying cityscape, Rick Miner, an off-the-books insurance investigator, is tasked with examining the suspicious death of an ex-con involving a million-dollar life insurance claim. While retracing the victim’s steps, Rick grows increasingly unsettled by the unfolding timeline of events and the uncertainty of his own sanity.

title: The Darkling Fox
overview: After getting trapped in an isolated woodland, a hunter is tormented by his former prey.
tagline: Survive as an Animal or Die as a Man

title: A Part of Me
overview: Young lovers, Anthony and Caroline, realize they're both harbouring a dark secret that brings them closer together. Much closer.

title: New Life
overview: A mysterious woman on the run, and the resourceful fixer assigned to bring her in. Their two unique stories inextricably link, as the stakes of the pursuit rise to apocalyptic proportions.

title: Booger
overview: After the death of her best friend Izzy, Anna focuses all her attention on Booger, the stray cat which she and Izzy took in. When Booger bites her, she begins to undergo a strange transformation.

title: New Fears Eve
overview: Unbeknownst to the trio, their corporate obligation will soon become a fight for survival. When The Doctor targets them, the celebration descends into a blood-soaked nightmare. Trapped in Hooper Industries' towering building, Leslie, Brian, Moses, and their unsuspecting colleagues must confront a deranged killer intent on making this night unforgettable-for all the wrong reasons.
tagline: The Doctor Will SLAY You Now!

title: The Influencer
overview: A social media influencer describes her perfect day harvesting the eyes and minds of her followers to achieve immortality.

title: In The Dark We Bleed
overview: A cleaner is called by her agency to cover for a colleague who hasn't shown up to work. After leaving her son with a babysitter, she travels to a large building to undergo the work, but she finds something waiting for her in the shadows.

title: Demons in the Closet
overview: A resident is challenged by demons from another realm in his closet.

title: Eight Eyes
overview: At the breaking point of their dysfunctional marriage, Cass and Gav take a trip through Serbia. After meeting a mysterious local, Saint Peter, who eagerly offers to be their guide, the couple embarks on an impromptu sightseeing expedition that soon takes a series of sinister turns.

title: Holistay
overview: Two couples, who do not know each other, double book a vacation house in San Diego and strange events begin to happen.

title: Night Explorers: The Asylum
overview: When a group of Urban Explores get the chance of a lifetime to explore one of the world's most haunted asylums, they encounter something truly evil, that will not let them leave and will push them to the edge of sanity.

title: Trial 22
overview: Trapped in a mysterious underground experiment, a group of people must survive against monsters, traps and each other.
tagline: Stay Quiet. Stay Together. Stay Alive.

title: Bitches Kill Bitches
overview: After the newest member of the popular clique receives a devastating breakup call during her initiation, the group must sing and dance their way to sisterhood and bloody revenge.

title: Sebastian
overview: Sabastian (2023) is serial killer (Luca Della Valle)  who sacrifices women to revive his long-dead lover, while two detectives (Torrei Hart, Dairus McCrary) race to stop his bloody ritual before he claims his next victim Irene played by Jamie Bernadette.

title: Bad CGI Gator
overview: Six college grads on spring break get a cabin in the swamplands of Georgia. Once there, they decide to throw their school laptops in a backyard lake in an act of youthful defiance, which unknowingly turns a lurking alligator into the dreaded and insatiable… BAD CGI GATOR!

title: Incubus
overview: An insomniac teenage girl receives a mysterious box. Strange things begin happening.

title: La Petite Mort
overview: After surviving a vicious attack, the body of a rigorous ballerina threatens to decay unless she placates a “certain hunger” to supplement her rotting flesh.

title: The Nightgown
overview: In 1976, three curious schoolgirls set out to unravel the mystery of a botched exorcism and untimely death of a young girl.

title: Bird Hostage
overview: Lauren takes a job pet-sitting Diane’s parrot. However, within the shroud of darkness and beneath a suspiciously placed sheet, Lauren finds Reggie, an African grey parrot, who longs for freedom and has a mouth like a sailor! Striking up a friendship, Lauren and Reggie hatch a plan for his escape

title: Nightmares Unleashed
overview: Nightmares Unleashed is a feature film based off the short film of the same name which is an oneiric style of film where a young lady gets sucked into the T.V and must escape her "nightmares" or the films she's watched.
tagline: This isn't your Dream, It's Our Nightmare!

title: This is Budget Productions
overview: Follow Budget Productions over the past 2 years. Diving into behind the scenes, bloopers, highlights, extended cuts, never before seen footage and the cancelled Virgin Wars: Ultimax.
tagline: WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT. IS WHAT MAKES US BUDGET PRODUCTIONS.

title: Skeletons in the Closet
overview: Haunted by a malevolent spirit since childhood, a desperate mother allows herself to become possessed in order to save the life of her terminally ill daughter.

title: After Hours
overview: A university student working after hours at a library looks for the source of a strange sound.

title: Draculaw
overview: In a world corrupted by power and greed, "Draculaw" presents the story of The Counselor, an evil lawyer with a sinister agenda. Exploiting the legal system's loopholes, The Counselor orchestrates an intricate web of needless laws that surreptitiously rob people of their precious time. With each stroke of his pen, he ensnares innocent lives, stealing their moments to fuel his insatiable hunger for control. As chaos mounts and society teeters on the brink of collapse, a courageous lawyer, Arc, armed with truth and determination, steps forward to expose The Counselor's malevolent schemes. Can Arc and his friends fight The Counselor and his Band of Monsters to restore the balance of Justice before it's too late? With horror, humor, action, and romance, "Draculaw" delivers a fun thrill ride.
tagline: HE'S A SUCKER FOR THE RULES.

title: Bring Her Back
overview: Following the death of their father, a brother and sister are sent to live with a foster mother, only to learn that she is hiding a terrifying secret.

title: Spider Baby
overview: A pair of greedy relatives try to repossess the Merrye Estate. But the inbred Children will protect their home and bloodline at all costs.

title: Stains
overview: As Erin packs her old life into boxes, she overhears a violent attack in the apartment above that derails her night.

title: Kennel
overview: Pat Hedlund, dog therapist, makes an unfortunate house call that will change her life. This film was made by the team Sound Speed for the Montana 48 Hour Film Project 2023. The team placed third overall in the state. The following criteria were given: horror (genre), Pat Hedlund the dog therapist (character/occupation), chopsticks (prop), and "you did what? When?" (dialogue).
tagline: Would you like to come in?

title: The Ringmaster
overview: Alma feels she has finally found an escape from her disturbing family life when she discovers an underground world of circus performers, but as she becomes a new muse to its enigmatic ringmaster, the fantasy devolves into a nightmare that feels uncannily familiar.

title: As Certain as Death
overview: A camping trip and forced intervention becomes a battle for survival, as five friends must fight not only their own demons but an evil in the woods.

title: Reindeer Slayer
overview: A Samurai is tasked with the killing of a Reindeer Man. Will either survive when looming darkness is afoot?

title: Pig Hill
overview: Carrie has been fascinated by the local legend of the pig people of Pig Hill, revolting creatures who breed and cause havoc in the area. As the tenth woman goes missing, Carrie can't stop thinking that there could be more to these stories.

title: WOACA
overview: A woman's skin-care routine ceases to be the bulwark she'd hoped.

title: Island Escape
overview: Trapped on an island, a team of mercenaries on a rescue mission begin to question everything around them as they encounter threatening creatures living in the shadows.

title: American Terror Tales 3
overview: Seven new tales of terror from the Heartland will rip your heart out.

title: Quiet
overview: A short psychological horror about a young couple (Natalie & Ethan) who are still at university. They move into a rental house that has an unknowingly haunted room.
tagline: "I didn't think it would be this charming."

title: Growth
overview: Zora and Izzy move into an old home that is within their budget. Strange things quickly begin to happen soon-after.
tagline: Who will water me now that you are gone?

original_title: Game of Death: The Six Doors to Hell
title: Game of Death: The Six Doors to Hell
overview: Set in a bleak future in which the world suffocates under the iron fist of a tyrannical regime. Driven by unyielding determination, Ken Shiro sets out on a perilous mission to find the gate to Hell and save his daughter from the Inferno.

title: I Know What You Need
overview: In 1976 on the University of Maine campus, Elizabeth Rogan is studying in the library when an odd boy comes up to her and says "I Know What You Need" - and he does. But how does he know? It's a love story - but a Stephen King love story - so things aren't always what they seem.
tagline: Elizabeth doesn't know what she wants. Edward knows what she needs.

title: The DoubleWalker
overview: An aimless twenty-something returns to her childhood home to find closure over a family tragedy, and instead discovers she may have inherited a sinister curse in this film shot entirely in Sedgwick, Maine, and inspired by Breton folklore.

title: Nash
overview: 9-year-old Nash is determined to find the monster that killed his mother; his father George is equally determined to stop him.

title: Dissociation
overview: In a final bid to save her career, a desperate researcher ventures to a secluded house during a raging thunderstorm, where she stumbles upon an ancient man whose obsession with a mysterious book unleashes mind-bending horrors.
tagline: Abondon Reality, Or Be Consumed By It

title: The Vance Institute
overview: In "The Vance Institute," led by Hannah New from "Black Sails," vulnerable individuals seek self-improvement only to find themselves trapped in a nightmarish prison. Confronting their deepest fears, they must choose: Resistance or Death.

title: Yule Log
overview: Two friends take their buddy to a secluded cabin to take his mind off the recent loss of his wife. What they don't expect is a night of terror after they unknowingly burn wood from a tree that has grown from a mound once used to burn a powerful witch! The cursed timber re-awakens dark spirits and creatures, forcing them, and a stranded woman, to fight for their lives during the Night of Mothers. This Yule Log burns forever, in hell!
tagline: The woods are alive with evil and monstrous, ancient entities!

title: Play Again?
overview: Ed gets caught up in a video game and takes the trip of his life
tagline: Ed gets caught up in a video game and takes the trip of his life

title: Possessions
overview: Follows a father who seeks a fresh start with his son after the loss of his wife, and purchased a storage unit facility sight unseen, but secrets buried behind the metal doors become a parent's worst nightmare.

title: Encounter
overview: Two students were on their way back to their dormitory when they were suddenly stalked by a mysterious undercover police officer.

title: Twin Waste
overview: A restless woman takes a harrowing walk in nature.

title: Haunted Ulster Live
overview: On Halloween night 1998, TV veteran Gerry Burns, teams up with popular children's presenter Michelle Kelly to investigate poltergeist activity in a haunted house in Belfast. A seance causes the broadcast to descend into chaos. When the youngest child is mysteriously abducted by an unseen force, the two presenters must face their greatest fears on live TV.
tagline: Halloween 1998. A live broadcast from a haunted house. So disturbing it hasn't been seen in 25 years...

title: Serenade
overview: An antiques dealer acquires  a mysterious music box that may hold terrifying secrets from its previous owner.
tagline: An antiques dealer acquired a mysterious music box that may hold terrifying secrets from its previous owner.

original_title: H. P. Lovecraft's The Old Ones
title: H. P. Lovecraft's The Old Ones
overview: In 1930, sea captain Russel Marsh saw the light, and for 93 years his body was not his own. Inhabited by a Great Old One, he committed unspeakable acts in the name of the Esoteric Order of Dagon. Now free, he is in search of a way to go back in time to reverse the horrors wrought upon the world. But the cult has other plans and will stop at nothing to destroy him.

title: Herd
overview: When a woman trying to outrun her past ends up trapped between a zombie outbreak and warring militia groups, she is caught in a world where some fight for survival but others fight for control.
tagline: Some fight for survival. Others fight for control.

title: The Morning After
overview: Jo and Sophie wake from a drunken lesbian encounter to find the house besieged by incels led by an erudite Big Gay Bunny. When Sophie's ex-boyfriend is discovered, he is forced to reclaim his manhood by doing one simple trick.

title: Paragon
overview: One quiet night in the summer of 1984, an MIT student discovers an unfathomable horror after accidentally inventing a computer program that can predict the future.

title: White Noise
overview: White Noise follows Ava, who suffers from misophonia - an extreme hyper-sensitivity to sound. When this reaches new terrifying heights, her doctor enrolls her in an experimental trial involving an anechoic chamber: the world's quietest room.

title: Hellmark
overview: There’s nothing like a happy ending when it comes to love, but where do couples from those generic holiday romance movies end up after they devote themselves to each other?

title: Instant Life
overview: A criminal gets more than he bargained for after robbing a magic shop.

title: The A-Frame
overview: A quantum physicist develops a machine that creates a tunnel to a subatomic universe. In his quest to prove the machine's efficacy, he inadvertently discovers a radical treatment for cancer in lab rats. He now seeks human volunteers.

title: Death of a Unicorn
overview: A father and daughter accidentally hit and kill a unicorn while en route to a weekend retreat, where his billionaire boss seeks to exploit the creature’s miraculous curative properties.

title: Departing Seniors
overview: After an act of bullying sends Javier to the hospital, he begins experiencing visions that foresee glimpses of shocking murders at his school right before they happen. Now, in between navigating the social hierarchies and prejudices of clique culture, Javier and his best friend Bianca must try to unmask a serial killer before he strikes again.

title: Whispering Pines
overview: Jeff and Harry embark on a nature walk, unaware of the horrors that await them within the whispering pines...

title: The Happy Hotel
overview: When a small group of friends unwittingly check into the peculiar Happy Hotel for a weekend escape, they discover that the real horror isn't just the tacky decor but the fact that their numbers keep shrinking one hilariously gruesome disappearance at a time. Now, they must outwit the hotel's sinister secrets if they ever hope to check out alive and with their sanity intact.

title: Play With Me
overview: An attention-seeking man takes drastic measures to repair his relationship with his absent boyfriend. 'Play With Me' follows Nate as he transforms himself into someone (or something) he believes is worth loving.
tagline: Nate plans an unconventional birthday present for his boyfriend.

original_title: Dos amigos regresan a casa solos de noche
title: Two Friends Walk Home Alone at Night
overview: Once again, the night sets in the city. Two young people look through faces on a phone, deciding and agreeing. ’He’s hot, him too.’ The decision is made before sunrise – a biology student with beautiful curly hair and shiny skin.

title: Dariuss
overview: The loss of a young girl... her family... devasted.  A remote house in the quiet English countryside of Essex...  ...each affected family member deals with much pain and loss differently.  A hand camera, a woman, high heels. hair scalps and a child.  What such a terrible tragedy can cause to an ordinary middle-class family is unbelievable.  An unspeakable. sickening and perverse cinematographic voyage of blood, bodily fluids and madness... like never seen before!  Partially filmed with the use of "meta-cinema" and "guerrilla filmmaking style" to recreate a whole new shocking level of ultra-realism, where underground and dark erotica blend together in a unique way and, where the author / director creates a "mirror effect" story...  ...with no room for sanity.  This is...DARIUSS !!!

original_title: Moonsoil : Gruesome Tales of Michele and the Modern Witch
title: Moonsoil : Gruesome Tales of Michele and the Modern Witch
overview: Water from the grave, a witch, a cross in the woods, an Unlord and his followers. A tale so terrifying, will you have the courage to finish the film?  Action, suspense, horror, mouth noises, and featuring the Breath of John Heim. Watch if you dare.

title: Island of the Dolls 2
overview: Influencers venture to the mysterious Island of the Dolls, only to be hunted by Santana, a malevolent spirit trapped within a supernaturally powerful doll. Fighting for survival, they realize Santana will not stop until she finds her perfect human host, while also discovering she is not the only danger…

original_title: The Haunted Movie Collection Chapter II
title: The Haunted Movie Collection Chapter II
overview: Jarno has been possessed by evil spirit of Batman and Robin. After acting weirdly, quoting the movie and adding too many copies to their movie collection, group of friends start to worry. They contact the exorcist to work things out.

title: The Reflection Of Francisca Newman
overview: In this cinematic fairytale, Francisca Newman, a psychologically disturbed ballerina, fails at her life audition. Her perfectionism starts to take a noticeable toll on her mental health, where in a world of passion and beauty, sensibility and enlightenment becomes darkness.  In this increasingly violent and surreal competition at the hands of her own reflection, a familiar voice starts talking to her as an old forgotten friend. A voice that takes her on a journey through her own memories in order to find herself, before her reflection becomes a stranger.
tagline: The enlightenment of passion can become a double-edge sword when you are no longer able to see the light

original_title: The Community Pool Lifeguard Cult of Doom!
title: The Community Pool Lifeguard Cult of Doom!
overview: When a naive everyman stumbles upon a rabble of CPR-certified zealots, he undergoes a series of trials in order to become one of them.

title: Murder
overview: A man is awoken suddenly by a knock at his window. His attempts to help the visitor put him in a precarious position.

title: The Management
overview: A story about incoming gentrification, even to the darkest mythical corners of the world. The power of the old gods is eternal, but it is nothing against the ubiquity of consumerism.  Two characters playing out all the stereotypes they got, to convince each other of an innocence that isn’t there on either side.
tagline: You'd like to talk to you manager? He will be pleased to meet you.

title: Creeping Death
overview: After a prank goes terribly wrong, Tim and his friends are hunted down by the Aos Si - a Celtic entity that walks the Earth on Halloween. They have until midnight to make things right... or die trying.

title: Transmission
overview: The world's first channel-surfing horror film, unfolding on a television screen as we switch between different channels and slowly realise that each of these channels is actually telling different aspects of the same horrific narrative.

title: Lore
overview: Four young thrill-seeking friends book a horror-themed camping excursion led by Darwin, a strange and eccentric guide, who one night encourages them to tell their scariest story around a fire. As they recount tales of sinister spirits and malevolent demons, the group soon realises that these stories will have very real consequences for them all.

title: The Moor
overview: Claire is approached by the father of her murdered childhood friend to help investigate the haunted moor he believes is his son's final resting place.
tagline: Out there, we are all lost.

title: Werewolf Santa
overview: Lucy has a social media channel where she hunts evidence of actual monsters, but it’s not doing great, with just a few viewers following her disappointing posts. Everything changes on Christmas Eve when her camera witnesses Santa getting bitten by a werewolf before he turns lycanthrope himself! As Werewolf Santa starts wreaking bloody havoc in their seaside town, Lucy and her bickering family set off on a madcap adventure armed with a rusty skate and a vague understanding of how to kill werewolves gained from her collection of horror comics. The Beast must die to save Christmas!

title: I Am Monsters!
overview: A FrightFest favourite guest and one of the UK's shining beacons in the queer horror scene is actor/director Nicholas Vince. title: Frankenstein
overview: FRANKENSTEIN (music, book & lyrics by Eric B. Sirota) is a sweeping romantic musical about the human need for love and companionship, based on Mary Shelley’s classic novel.  Mary Shelley’s Frankenstein was first published in 1818, and this work honors that source material as a contemporary work of musical theatre.  Having lost his mother at a young age, Victor Frankenstein seeks to end human mortality and arrogantly enters territory beyond his control. While he enjoys unconditional love from Elizabeth, he grants none to his creation.  The Off-Broadway production of Sirota’s FRANKENSTEIN opened in 2017 and ran for nearly 3 years in the NYC theatre district at St. Luke’s Theatre, where it achieved acclaim. That production was re-staged especially for film in what is an exciting new hybrid between a recorded version of a stage performance and a movie musical.

Through flashbacks, Victor reveals their macabre attempts to create superhuman soldiers. The trial becomes a stage for ethical debates, exploring the fine line between scientific inquiry and culpability. The narrative exposes the moral ambiguity of each scientist, offering a poignant reflection on the consequences when intellect collides with wartime horrors, making it a riveting exploration of human nature.

title: The Resurrection Man

The video purported to show actual evidence of demonic possession as captured during an unauthorized exorcism. In less than 72 hours, the video received more than 8 million views. The 61 minute video drew instant criticism and complaints claiming that what it actually showed was the abuse and torture of a mentally ill man by members of his church. The video was removed by Youtube for violating their content agreement. This documentary examines the 61 minute video known only as 'The Resurrection Man'.

overview: Two friends set out on a road trip in search of adventure, but their journey takes an unexpected turn when they arrive in a remote small town. The locals warn them not to stay out after dark, offering little explanation for their concern. As night falls, the pair begins to uncover the horrifying reason behind the town's warning and struggles to survive the night.

title: Screen Time

Terrified, she hides under the covers, then peeks out and spots a figure sitting in the dark corner of her room. Each time she looks, it's closer.

title: The Spot
overview: Three friends by the name of Jake, Samuel, and Dave decide to visit a local forest preserve to smoke weed on their day off from classes. Jake (Nicholas B. Mora) brings up the idea of going to a particular area that he's familiar with. Along with some drinks and music, the guys are off to have a fun time. On the way to the woods, Jake mentions that he's heard on the news that a guy invited their cousin to the woods only for the police to find 1 of them slaughtered to death near a human bone ritual site........no comment is made on the other cousin. While this story cracks fear into Dave, both Samuel and Jake brush off the subject like it's another day off because they only came to the woods for one reason: to smoke their lungs out; they are in the perfect spot, after all. Meanwhile, an electric, sinister evil is unleashed into the woods, striking down anyone it encounters. This is The Hand of Darkness.
